purpose: Index of unchanged historical publication-run archives recovered from experiment.zip
archive_policy: Original tar.gz bytes are retained unchanged. The Release SHA256SUMS.txt uses portable basenames; the original E4 checksum sidecar used an HPC absolute path.
validation_scope: Archive identity, retained run structure, selected source/result mappings and saved checksums were checked. No full performance or integrity experiment was rerun.

notes: Formal storage-accounting run; sample_results and results_example are not the publication-run source.
